prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. depth.jpg, segmentation.jpg and pose.jpg are the same 5 frames rendered as a monocular depth map (brighter = nearer to the camera wearer), an instance segmentation map (coloured masks with class labels), and a body/hand skeleton map (yellow = body, magenta = hands) on black. Look at all four images. For EACH of the three maps, describe the spatial understanding that map supports, using the RGB strip for context: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Say what each map shows that is hard to see in the RGB alone, and where the map looks unreliable. Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"depth": "...", "segmentation": "...", "pose": "..."} with 3-5 sentences each.

descriptions.depth: The depth map captures the receding geometry of a wide enclosed staircase flanked by side walls and an overhead circular chandelier, separating three foreground tiers of people ascending ahead of the camera wearer. A man in a white shirt on the left and a person in a dark cap/helmet on the lower right remain within arm's reach (roughly 0.5–1.0 m away, brightly lit in white) in frames 1–4 before moving out of the left and right edges in frame 5, while a woman in a black top directly in front closes from about 2.5 m to 1.2 m (nearly within arm's reach) by frame 5 and partially occludes the stairs and group ahead. Further up the stairs, a cluster of four people (a woman in a patterned dress on the left, a woman in a light dress at center, a man in a grey shirt, and a man on the right carrying a green bag within his arm's reach) stands roughly 3–5 m away and 0.5–1.5 m apart from one another, all facing away and above the camera wearer except in frame 3 where the woman in the patterned dress turns her head back toward the camera. Compared to RGB alone, the continuous brightness gradient clearly orders the longitudinal depth of the overlapping crowd and step risers as everyone advances upward, though the map is unreliable inside the upper doorway beyond 6–8 m where distant pedestrians and architectural details collapse into uniform black and where thin handrails blend into the walls.
descriptions.segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates individual pedestrians and carried accessories across the ascending crowd, resolving up to ten distinct people from the immediate foreground (0.5–1.0 m) to the upper landing (roughly 7–10 m away in frames 1–2) even where similarly dark clothing blends into the dim stairwell in RGB. In the foreground, it separates the man in white on the lower left (0.5–1.0 m, cut off at the bottom and left edges in frames 1–4) and the person on the lower right (labelled as a backpack in frame 1 and suitcase in frame 4 at 0.5–1.0 m) from the woman in black at center-front (1.2–2.5 m), while also segmenting her blue shoulder strap as a handbag within her arm's reach in frames 3 and 5. Above and behind her at 3–5 m, four closely spaced people (within 0.5–1.5 m of each other) climb the stairs facing away from the camera wearer, with the rightmost man's green tote bag segmented as a handbag at his side in frame 3 and the leftmost woman turning her head back toward the camera in frame 3 before everyone shifts higher and closer to the top edge by frame 5. The map is unreliable in several places: it completely misses the walls, stairs, and handrails, splits the foreground-left man into two separate person masks in frame 4, misclassifies the foreground-right person's headgear as a backpack or suitcase, and hallucinate a large teal person mask along the right handrail and wall in frame 5.
descriptions.pose: The pose map is extremely sparse, detecting only a few isolated yellow body keypoints and failing to render any magenta hand skeletons across all five frames despite multiple people standing within 0.5–5 m in the RGB strip. In frame 1, it places small clusters of head/facial keypoints on the foreground man on the left (about 0.8 m away, facing forward and slightly right) and on the woman in black ahead of him (about 2.5 m away, facing away up the stairs), while frame 2 contains no detections at all. In frame 3, it renders a single upright torso-and-leg skeleton for the woman in the patterned dress roughly 3.5 m away and above the camera wearer on the left side of the stairs, capturing her twisted posture as she turns her head to look back toward the camera wearer while her left leg steps up. In frame 5, after the closer flanking individuals exit the field of view, it detects only the rear shoulder-and-arm outline and head keypoints of the woman in the black top centered about 1.2 m in front of the camera wearer facing away, making the map largely unreliable for tracking the surrounding group, their hands, or the spatial layout shown in RGB.
